applicabilityBasis.summary: spUSDT is an ERC-4626 savings-vault share whose redemption rate increases with yield. Redemptions return underlying assets at the vault exchange rate rather than a fixed amount of national currency.

genius.notes: Reviewed as the spUSDT V2 savings-vault share under GENIUS section 2(22). Spark documents USDT deposits, USDS backing and yield generated by the Spark Liquidity Layer. The wrapper has its own scope classification; USDT issuer classifications and licenses do not transfer to the vault share. No GENIUS payment-stablecoin authorization is asserted.
